judged_text: PollFeed calls `i.content.scrub`, but plain RSS 2.0 feeds expose the body as `description`, not `content`, so `i.content` is nil/undefined and `.scrub` raises NoMethodError. The hourly poll job crashes on the first item of any RSS 2.0 feed that uses <description> instead of <content:encoded>; with `sidekiq_options retry: false` the crash is swallowed and feed polling is silently and permanently dead — no topics are ever created and no error is surfaced to the operator.

The hourly poll job crashes on the first item of any RSS 2.0 feed that uses <description> instead of <content:encoded>; with `sidekiq_options retry: false` the crash is swallowed and feed polling is silently and permanently dead — no topics are ever created and no error is surfaced to the operator.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the job does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. If `SimpleRSS` items for some feeds do not provide `content` (e.g., only `description`), then `i.content` would be `nil` and calling `.scrub` would raise `NoMethodError`, aborting the job mid-run. The diff shows no nil-guard or fallback (like `i.description`), so the job is brittle and can crash on valid feeds.
